name: Question 11
problem: Consider the collection of point masses ${m}_{1}=5\,\text{kg},$ ${m}_{2}=1\,\text{kg},$ ${m}_{3}=2\,\text{kg},$ and ${m}_{4}=4\,\text{kg}$ located at ${x}_{1}=1,$ ${x}_{2}=4,$ ${x}_{3}=0.5,$ and ${x}_{4}=1.5,$ respectively, along the $x$-axis, where the $x$-coordinates are measured in meters. What is the $x$-coordinate of the center of mass for this system?
worked_solution:
The center of mass, denoted $\overset{―}{x},$ of a collection of point masses ${m}_{1},{m}_{2},…,{m}_{n}$ located at ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n}$ along the $x$-axis is given by 

$$
\overset{―}{x}=\frac{{M}_{O}}{m},
$$

 

where 

- $m={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{m}_{i}$ is the total mass of the system,

- ${M}_{O}={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{m}_{i}{x}_{i}$ is the total moment of the system about the origin $O.$

In our case, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{m}_{1} & =5, & \,{m}_{2} & =1, & \,{m}_{3} & =2, & \,{m}_{4} & =4, \\ {x}_{1} & =1, & \,{x}_{2} & =4, & \,{x}_{3} & =0.5, & \,{x}_{4} & =1.5.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the total mass of the system is

$$
\begin{aligned}m & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{m}_{i} \\  & ={m}_{1}+{m}_{2}+{m}_{3}+{m}_{4} \\  & =5+1+2+4 \\  & =12\,\text{kg}\end{aligned}
$$

and the moment of the system about the origin is

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{O} & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{m}_{i}{x}_{i} \\  & ={m}_{1}{x}_{1}+{m}_{2}{x}_{2}+{m}_{3}{x}_{3}+{m}_{4}{x}_{4} \\  & =5\cdot 1+1\cdot 4+2\cdot 0.5+4\cdot 1.5 \\  & =5+4+1+6 \\  & =16\,\text{kg}\cdot \text{m}.\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, 

$$
\overset{―}{x}=\frac{{M}_{O}}{m}=\frac{16}{12}=\frac{4}{3}.
$$

Question 11
?

Consider the collection of point masses m1=5kg, m2=1kg, m3=2kg, and m4=4kg located at x1=1, x2=4, x3=0.5, and x4=1.5, respectively, along the x-axis, where the x-coordinates are measured in meters. What is the x-coordinate of the center of mass for this system?

a
 113
b
 4116
c
 2312
d
43
e
 134
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The center of mass, denoted x―, of a collection of point masses m1,m2,…,mn located at x1,x2,…,xn along the x-axis is given by

x―=MOm,

where

  • m=∑i=1nmi is the total mass of the system,

  • MO=∑i=1nmixi is the total moment of the system about the origin O.

In our case, we have

m1=5,m2=1,m3=2,m4=4,x1=1,x2=4,x3=0.5,x4=1.5.

So, the total mass of the system is

m=∑i=1nmi=m1+m2+m3+m4=5+1+2+4=12kg

and the moment of the system about the origin is

MO=∑i=1nmixi=m1x1+m2x2+m3x3+m4x4=5⋅1+1⋅4+2⋅0.5+4⋅1.5=5+4+1+6=16kg⋅m.

Therefore,

x―=MOm=1612=43.
